format: five-panel vector drawing from deposited scientific records

panels.b: neutral, ionic and precursor donor forms
panels.e: NP and NR category fractions for candidate molecules and experimental pairs

notes: The PNG is a 600-dpi rendering of the vector PDF.
Molecular structures are read from the deposited candidate and experimental-input records.
Structural association arrows do not denote chemical transformations or independently documented replacement decisions.
NP and NR are separate ordinal classifications; their different populations are not a paired before/after comparison.
